pr_title: Remove parallel node processing in PreFilter stage in volumerestrictions scheduler plugin
pr_body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind feature

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

This change creates a `StorageInfoLister` interface
and have it under scheduler `SharedLister`.

The initial `StorageInfoLister` interface has a
`IsPVCUsedByPods` API which returns true/false depending on
whether the PVC (keyed by namespace/name) has at least
one scheduled pod using it.

In snapshot real implementation, add a `usedPVCSet`
key by PVC namespace/name which contains all PVCs
that have at least one scheduled pod using it.
During snapshot update, populate this set based on
whether the PVCRefCounts map for node(s) have been
updated since last snapshot.

With the `usedPVCSet` in snapshot, we can now determine
whether a PVC with ReadWriteOncePod access mode is being
used by another scheduled pod to achieve O(1) look up in
PreFilter and avoid needing to parallel process all nodes in the
`volumerestrictions` scheduler plugin.

issue_context.title: Optimize a O(n) operation in volumerestrictions#PreFilter
issue_context.body:
A principle of writing a scheduler PreFilter/PreScore plugin is to iterate all nodes **when necessay**. If it's just a good-to-have, we usually delay the O(n) operator to Filter()/Score() on each node.

Two valid examples for this is InterPodAffinity and PodTopologySpread's PreFilter(), which **need** to calculate the inter-pod relationship across all nodes, and used in Filter() later on.

However, @yibozhuang reported that the usage pattern of volumerestriction looks a bit strange:

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/537941765fe1304dd096c1a2d4d4e70f10768218/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/volumerestrictions/volume_restrictions.go#L165-L175

Given we've already plumbed some helper structure in `NodeInfo`, I think it's technically doable to eliminate the O(n) loop by plumbing a bit more structure to the snapshot level, and expose the facility function via a `SharedLister#StorageInfos()`. With this way, we should change the O(n) operation `volumerestrictions#PreFilter` in O(1) time.

The `SharedLister#StorageInfos()` is also related to the idea of #89312.

/kind enhancement
/sig scheduling
